{{short description|Japanese mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=May 2020}}
{{Nihongo|'''Yutaka Yamamoto'''|山本 裕|Yamamoto Yutaka|born 29 March 1950}}, is a Japanese [[mathematician]] working in [[systems theory]], [[control theory]], and [[signal processing]].

*[http://www-ics.acs.i.kyoto-u.ac.jp/yyfest/index.html YYfest 2010 Symposium on Systems, Control, and Signal Processing In honor of Yutaka Yamamoto on the occasion of his 60th birthday Kyoto University. 29–31 March 2010]
*{{cite book|editor1=Jan C. Willems|editor2=Shinji Hara|editor3=Yoshito Ohta|editor4=Hisaya Fujioka|title=Perspectives in Mathematical System Theory, Control, and Signal Processing: A Festschrift in Honor of Yutaka Yamamoto on the Occasion of his 60th Birthday|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=L7Tw2yTKPZsC|year=2010|publisher=Springer Science & Business Media|isbn=978-3-540-93917-7}}
